Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Nature of Work: Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for all existing Endress and Hauser make Servo gauges an d indicators for a period of 2 years in Jamshedpur BP. Scope of Work: The scope of work shall include but not be limited to the following: a) Span, functional and hardware checking of all gauges. b) Preventive maintenance of all the Servo gauges. c) Calibration of the Servo gauges as per requirement. d) Software backups and snag rectification. e) To check the healthiness of Communications, electronics cards, software and Overall systems i n all respect. f) Unlimited online support to resolve any issue related to Endress +Hauser instruments at any p oint of time. g) Tenderer shall be liable to attend any Breakdown maintenance call within 02 days of intimatio n and Preventive maintenance call within seven days of intimation. h) Total 2 preventive visits and 2 emergency visits are taken under this contract. i) Replacement of parts: -The spares will be supplied by IOCL as per requirement. The details of minimum recommended spares, which shall be required, would be provided by M/s E+H (before carrying out the AMC job). j) Any other services which are not mentioned but which may be felt necessary to ensure smooth operation of the Instruments during AMC period. · All the works as defined above are a part of AMC and IOCL will not pay extra for any of the above works d uring AMC.
